description: Mint a new Pondchat room (pond) for video/audio/chat. Returns room URL and WebSocket endpoint. This is the only way to create a room — for metadata of an existing roomId, use get_room_info (read-only). Note: a custom roomId is not reserved — if another pond already uses it, you share the same door.

label.description: Optional label for the room (max 64 chars). Useful for identifying the room purpose.

roomId.description: Optional custom room ID (3-64 chars, alphanumeric + _-). If not provided, a random ID is generated.

source.description: Optional source identifier (max 64 chars). Tracks which agent created the room.

name: create_pond
title: Create pond
